test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech. He said, "I don't like spicy food."

options.text: He said that he hadn't liked spicy food.
He said that he likes spicy food.
He said that he didn't like spicy food.
He said that he doesn't like spicy food.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he didn’t like spicy food.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I don’t like" becomes "he didn’t like"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the reporting verb.
 
• Verb "don’t like" in present tense is converted to "didn’t like" in past tense, as the reporting verb "said" is in the past tense.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is restructured to match the indirect format, using conjunction "that" to connect the reporting clause.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said that he didn’t like spicy food."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said that he hadn’t liked spicy food." 

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "hadn’t liked" implies a past perfect tense, which is not appropriate as the original sentence is in present simple tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He said that he likes spicy food." 
 
 
• Incorrect meaning: This option changes the sentence to an affirmative statement, which contradicts the original negative statement.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said that he doesn’t like spicy food." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "doesn’t like" is in present tense, but the reporting verb "said" is in past tense, so the verb should also be in past tense.
